pages.text: {{hero}} has a red rocket. {{hero}} gets in and sits. Up, up, up! It zips to space. {{hero}} and the rocket zip and zip.
{{hero}} can see a big tan rock. Can {{hero}} get to it? {{hero}} has a map and a pen. {{hero}} can get to it!
But the rocket did not go. It sat and sat. {{hero}} has to fix it. {{hero}} gets a rod and a pin.
{{hero}} tugs on a red lid. Zip, zap, zip! The rocket is on. Up it gets, to the tan rock. {{hero}} hops on it. It is fun!
{{hero}} gets into bed in the rocket. Mom is on the pad. But tap, tap, tap! What is on the lid of the rocket?
